name: Riffle
summary: A 4-digit code field made of playing cards that flip up, shuffle and fan out on success
about: Each digit you type flips a playing card face up on a felt card table. When the fourth card lands the deck shuffles, then the hand fans out with a gold chip if the code is right, or flips face down if it is wrong. Fun for game sites, wallets and any login that sends a one-time code.
how: Type the demo code, paste it, or use backspace and the arrow keys to move between cards
Every digit flips its card face up and the next card lifts, ready for input
After the last digit the cards gather in the middle and riffle-shuffle
A right code fans the hand out with a gold check chip; a wrong one shakes and flips the cards back
Use Deal again or Send a new code to start over
